answer: First, the beacon fires each epoch: a VRF draw selects 5% of identities for proof of work. Then, the chosen identity has 2 epochs to submit a beacon-bound work proof for 7 jurors. Finally, absence is punished: missing the check freezes rewards for 6 epochs; a second miss slashes 50% of the stake. A ridge of idle clones cannot hide: the draw is random, and the terrace is flat for all. Forging 1,000 identities locks 120,000 units; 5% drawn per epoch means about 50 clones are checked each round, and missed checks on the reef cost about 6,000 units per round.
